note.label: Standing Tall When The Smoke Clears

precepts.why:
A lot of Christians quote Philippians 4, I can do all things through Christ, but they don’t understand Paul’s resume. “For I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.” I have learned: stripes, beaten with rods, shipwreck, all those things.

“I know both how to be abased”: he had been abased many times and stayed in the spirit and kept fighting the fight, “and I know how to abound”. “Every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.” How do you know that if you never suffered adversity? You don’t know you until God tries you.

“I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.” Christians isolate that verse, but they don’t understand all it takes to get you to that spiritual level.

points: Be careful for nothing: so the Lord said be careful for nothing. Don't worry about nothing. Cuz remember we read earlier in this class, cast all your cares upon him, for he careth for you. So don't stress on things. Don't let your mind get to heaviness. We read that in Sirach 30. Put it on the Lord. Let him deal with the problems that we focus on all the time, and let us focus on doing the will of God.
Let your requests be made known unto God: cast your burdens on God.

And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus: so this is the habit. We must replace those bad habits we have, those negative thoughts we have, with what we going to read now.

Think on these things: we must think on truth, honesty, justice, pure, lovely, a good report, virtue, and praise. We got to change those bad habits to those good habits. How? We just read in the book of Ezra 7 and 10. Prepare our mind.
